records.context: Names are split into tokens (at ``_ - . space``, and failing that into digit and letter runs); the tokens that vary are found; one is tried as the image data channel -- or, when the user assigned image data channels, the tokens that only follow the image data channel are set aside -- and the rest must identify a set that holds exactly one image per image data channel. Each candidate is checked with :func:`check_sets` before it is returned. spaCR's own Yokogawa pattern is tried first and returned when it passes; :func:`spacr.regex_infer.propose` is tried last. Of the other candidates that pass, the one with the fewest image data channels is returned, the earliest on a tie, because a regex that reads each name as its own image data channel in a single set also passes the check.
records.label: spacr.channel_sorting.infer_regex#1
records.source: Names are split into tokens (at ``_ - . space``, and failing that into digit and letter runs); the tokens that vary are found; one is tried as the channel -- or, when the user assigned channels, the tokens that only follow the channel are set aside -- and the rest must identify a set that holds exactly one image per channel. Each candidate is checked with :func:`check_sets` before it is returned. spaCR's own Yokogawa pattern is tried first and returned when it passes; :func:`spacr.regex_infer.propose` is tried last. Of the other candidates that pass, the one with the fewest channels is returned, the earliest on a tie, because a regex that reads each name as its own channel in a single set also passes the check.
records.translation: Los nombres se dividen en tokens (en ``_ - . space`` y, si eso no basta, en secuencias de dígitos y de letras); se buscan los tokens que varían; se prueba uno como canal -- o, cuando el usuario asignó los canales, se apartan los tokens que solo siguen al canal -- y el resto debe identificar un conjunto que contenga exactamente una imagen por canal. Cada candidato se comprueba con :func:`check_sets` antes de devolverse. El patrón Yokogawa propio de spaCR se prueba primero y se devuelve cuando supera la comprobación; :func:`spacr.regex_infer.propose` se prueba en último lugar. De los demás candidatos que la superan, se devuelve el que tiene menos canales, el primero en caso de empate, porque una expresión regular que lee cada nombre como su propio canal en un único conjunto también supera la comprobación.

records.context: the Yokogawa pattern when it passes, otherwise the passing candidate with the fewest channels, or None.
records.label: spacr.channel_sorting.infer_regex#4
records.source: the Yokogawa pattern when it passes, otherwise the passing candidate with the fewest channels, or None.
records.translation: el patrón Yokogawa cuando supera la comprobación; en caso contrario, el candidato que la supera con menos canales, o None.

records.context: Base provenance is kept: external names are never turned into image identities just because they happen to be unique. One-to-one joins, once validated, still go through the same typed plan on their singleton groups, so explicit count and nunique overrides stay real. Data-selection boundary and filter identities use timeID, and the original time_id spelling is preserved too, so a chart that selects time_id stays reproducible.
records.label: spacr.derived_tables.execute#5
records.source: Base provenance is kept: external names are never turned into image identities just because they happen to be unique. One-to-one joins, once validated, still go through the same typed plan on their singleton groups, so explicit count and nunique overrides stay real. Gate and filter identities use timeID, and the original time_id spelling is preserved too, so a chart that selects time_id stays reproducible.
records.translation: La procedencia base se conserva: los nombres externos nunca se convierten en identidades de imagen solo porque resulten ser únicos. Las uniones uno a uno, una vez validadas, siguen pasando por el mismo plan tipado sobre sus grupos de un solo elemento, de modo que las sustituciones explícitas de count y nunique siguen siendo reales. Las identidades de compuertas y filtros usan timeID, y la grafía original time_id también se conserva, de modo que un gráfico que selecciona time_id sigue siendo reproducible.

records.source: Explicit worker cleanup requests take precedence and collect all generations, even below their normal thresholds. Next, once nothing defers them, come the freezes :func:`_freeze_survivors` asked for: if a window frozen alive has been deleted since, the frozen objects are returned to the collector first; then the unfrozen generations are collected and the survivors frozen.
records.translation: Las solicitudes explícitas de limpieza de los procesos de trabajo tienen prioridad y recolectan todas las generaciones, incluso por debajo de sus umbrales normales. A continuación, en cuanto nada las aplaza, vienen las congelaciones que pidió :func:`_freeze_survivors`: si una ventana congelada viva se ha eliminado desde entonces, los objetos congelados se devuelven primero al recolector; después se recolectan las generaciones no congeladas y se congelan los supervivientes.

records.context: spaCR arrays are scientific intensity image layers or label masks, including arrays whose leading dimension happens to contain three or four image layers. Declaring ``minisblack`` prevents image data channel/z/time stacks from being mislabeled as color, while ``contig`` makes the planar choice explicit.

records.source: spaCR arrays are scientific intensity planes or label masks, including arrays whose leading dimension happens to contain three or four planes. Tifffile historically guessed RGB for those shapes and is changing that guess. Declaring ``minisblack`` prevents channel/z/time stacks from being mislabeled as color, while ``contig`` makes the planar choice explicit.
records.translation: Las matrices de spaCR son planos de intensidad científicos o máscaras de etiquetas, incluidas matrices cuya dimensión inicial resulta contener tres o cuatro planos. Históricamente, tifffile suponía RGB para esas formas y está cambiando esa suposición. Declarar ``minisblack`` evita que las pilas de canales/z/tiempo se etiqueten erróneamente como color, mientras que ``contig`` hace explícita la elección planar.

records.context: Tracking representation
records.label: spacr.timeflows_baseline#10
records.source: Tracking representation
records.translation: Representación del seguimiento

records.context: The Cell Tracking Challenge convention, because the metrics are its: a label stack where the label is the track id, so an object keeps its label for as long as it is the same object, plus an optional lineage mapping each label to its parent label. A division is therefore two new labels whose parent is the old one; a tracker that cannot express divisions passes no lineage and is charged for the two missing parent edges, as the plain stitcher is.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_baseline#11
records.source: The Cell Tracking Challenge convention, because the metrics are its: a label stack where the label is the track id, so an object keeps its label for as long as it is the same object, plus an optional lineage mapping each label to its parent label. A division is therefore two new labels whose parent is the old one; a tracker that cannot express divisions passes no lineage and is charged for the two missing parent edges, as the plain stitcher is.
records.translation: La convención del Cell Tracking Challenge, porque las métricas son suyas: una pila de etiquetas en la que la etiqueta es el id de la trayectoria, de modo que un objeto conserva su etiqueta mientras sea el mismo objeto, más un linaje opcional que asocia cada etiqueta a su etiqueta progenitora. Una división es, por tanto, dos etiquetas nuevas cuyo progenitor es la antigua; un rastreador que no puede expresar divisiones no pasa ningún linaje y se le penalizan las dos aristas de progenitor que faltan, como al cosedor simple.

records.translation: Relación con ``spacr.timelapse``

records.context: Step 2 of the timeflows plan is a baseline score. Before a third Cellpose head is written, trained and maintained, every frame is segmented independently, the frames are linked by mask overlap, and the result is scored against the ground truth with the standard Cell Tracking Challenge measures. The fork's result is compared with this score; the plan accepts "the plain stitcher is already good enough" as a possible outcome.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_baseline#2
records.source: Step 2 of the timeflows plan is a baseline score. Before a third Cellpose head is written, trained and maintained, every frame is segmented independently, the frames are linked by mask overlap, and the result is scored against the ground truth with the standard Cell Tracking Challenge measures. The fork's result is compared with this score; the plan accepts "the plain stitcher is already good enough" as a possible outcome.
records.translation: El paso 2 del plan de timeflows es una puntuación de referencia. Antes de escribir, entrenar y mantener una tercera cabeza de Cellpose, cada fotograma se segmenta de forma independiente, los fotogramas se enlazan por solapamiento de máscaras y el resultado se puntúa frente a la verdad de referencia con las medidas estándar del Cell Tracking Challenge. El resultado de la bifurcación se compara con esta puntuación; el plan acepta "the plain stitcher is already good enough" (el cosedor simple ya es suficientemente bueno) como resultado posible.
